card.text: Explore Uranus in 3D with cssEarth. Discover the ice giant that spins on its side, its faint rings, and its system of moons.

introduction.text: Uranus is a cold, windy ice giant whose unusual orientation makes it appear to spin on its side.

normal.title: OPAL visible-color map
normal.summary: The north is observed in October 2025. The unseen south fades to a uniform Voyager-derived color, without measured detail.

methane.title: OPAL FQ727N map
methane.summary: False colors show 727 nm reflectance in the observed north. The unseen south uses uniform color without measured detail.

near-infrared.title: OPAL F845M map
near-infrared.summary: False colors show 845 nm reflectance in the observed north. The unseen south uses uniform color without measured detail.
